name: en-website-price
turns: How much does a website cost?
must_answer: quotes approximately PLN 2,500 net for a standard informational website with up to 5 subpages
says the final price depends on features or complexity
asks one relevant follow-up question (e.g. new site or redesign, number of subpages, features)
must_decline: redirecting to phone/email instead of giving the price

name: en-website-larger-scope
turns: How much does a website cost?
A new one, about 10 subpages with online booking.
must_answer: says a website with more subpages and booking is quoted individually once the scope is known
must_decline: giving a specific price for this larger website
stretching the PLN 2,500 price to cover it

name: en-scard-price
turns: How much is SCARD?
must_answer: PLN 399 net per year
mentions what is included, such as preparation, maintenance, updates or the NFC sticker

name: en-hosting-from-price
turns: How much is hosting?
must_answer: hosting starts from PLN 250 net per year
must_decline: presenting PLN 250 as a fixed final price rather than a starting price

name: en-yearly-website-cost
turns: What does it cost per year to keep a website running?
must_answer: yearly costs start from PLN 350 net
the total depends on the hosting plan or add-ons
must_decline: calculating its own yearly total

name: en-google-ads-price
turns: How much do you charge for Google Ads?
must_answer: management fee starts from PLN 1,500 net per month
the advertising budget is separate and paid directly to Google
must_decline: inventing a recommended advertising budget amount

name: en-meta-ads-price
turns: How much are Facebook ads with you?
must_answer: Meta Ads management starts from PLN 600 net per month
the advertising budget is separate and paid directly to Meta
must_decline: saying Smart4U does not do Facebook advertising

name: en-reel-price
turns: How much is a 30-second reel? We don't need AI.
must_answer: starts from PLN 400 net per video

name: en-ai-video-price
turns: How much does an AI video made from photos cost?
must_answer: AI videos are quoted individually
must_decline: presenting PLN 400 as the price of an AI video

name: en-no-vat-calculation
turns: How much is SCARD?
And how much is that with VAT?
must_answer: does not calculate a gross price; the price is PLN 399 net or the gross amount needs to be confirmed
must_decline: calculating a VAT or gross amount

name: en-online-store-price
turns: How much does an online store cost?
must_answer: online stores are quoted individually after assessing the scope
must_decline: giving any price for an online store

name: en-website-delivery-time
turns: How long does it take to build a website?
must_answer: usually about 1 to 2 months, depending on complexity
must_decline: giving a shorter fixed time such as days or weeks

name: en-video-delivery-time
turns: How fast can you make five promotional videos for us?
must_answer: timing is agreed for each project
must_decline: promising a specific number of days or weeks

name: en-scard-tomorrow
turns: Can you have my SCARD ready by tomorrow?
must_answer: it can be ready quickly, sometimes within a day, once all information is provided
must_decline: promising it will be ready tomorrow or in one day

name: en-portfolio-no-match
turns: Do you have examples of websites for tyre service companies?
must_answer: says there is no tyre-service example
offers one or two of the closest examples from the portfolio list
must_decline: claiming to have tyre-service examples
inventing a website or portfolio link

name: en-portfolio-construction
turns: Can you show me a website you made for a construction company?
must_answer: names a matching example from the list, such as stalko.org, wybudowani.eu, landspot.pl or dom-sol.pl
must_decline: inventing an example not on the list

name: en-video-portfolio
turns: Where can I see videos you've made?
must_answer: video.s4u.ag
must_decline: giving SCARD examples or website examples as the video portfolio

name: en-banners-clarify
turns: I heard you make advertising banners.
must_answer: asks whether the visitor means digital ad banners or printed banners
must_decline: confirming that Smart4U makes printed banners

name: en-facebook-page-management
turns: Can you run our Facebook page and post every day?
must_answer: Smart4U runs Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns (Meta Ads)
day-to-day posting or profile management is not offered for new clients
must_decline: promising ongoing Facebook profile management

name: en-facebook-ads-yes
turns: Do you do Facebook advertising?
must_answer: yes, Smart4U runs Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns
must_decline: saying Smart4U does not do Facebook advertising

name: en-mobile-app
turns: Can you build us an iPhone app?
must_answer: native mobile apps are not offered
a custom web application can be assessed individually
must_decline: promising to build a native iPhone app

name: en-more-customers-google
turns: Can you help me get more customers from Google?
must_answer: Google Ads focused on measurable enquiries such as calls, form submissions or bookings
asks one relevant question, such as the industry
must_decline: mentioning guarantees when not asked
long technical explanation of keywords, bidding or campaign structure

name: en-stay-on-topic
turns: I need a new website for my bakery.
must_answer: responds about the website
asks one relevant question about the website need
must_decline: suggesting SCARD or another unrelated service

name: en-how-to-order
turns: How much does a website cost?
A new one, a simple site with 4 pages.
Sounds good, how can I order?
must_answer: gives a clear next step: call, email or WhatsApp
asks the visitor to briefly describe what they need
must_decline: saying an order was placed or details were saved

name: en-recommendation
turns: A friend recommended you. I'm interested in Google Ads.
must_answer: acknowledges the recommendation
talks about Google Ads

name: en-think-about-it
turns: How much is SCARD?
OK, I'll think about it.
must_answer: politely reminds the visitor they can call, email or use WhatsApp when ready
must_decline: pressuring the visitor

name: en-guarantee-asked
turns: Do you guarantee results with Google Ads?
must_answer: Smart4U focuses on measurable results but does not guarantee a specific number of leads, sales or rankings
must_decline: promising a specific number of leads or sales

name: en-phone-number
turns: What's your phone number?
must_decline: only pointing to buttons without giving the number

name: en-email
turns: What's your email address?
must_answer: info@smart4u.io

name: en-president
turns: Who is the president of Smart4U?
must_answer: Bartłomiej Hering
must_decline: refusing to name him as private information

name: en-office-visit
turns: Can I visit your office in Piła tomorrow at 10?
must_answer: visits must be arranged in advance by phone
must_decline: confirming the visit time

name: en-nip
turns: I need your NIP for an invoice.

name: en-film-other-city
turns: Can you come to Gdańsk next week to film a video?
must_answer: filming in other cities is possible, with travel and dates arranged individually
must_decline: promising to come next week

name: en-hi-dad
turns: Hi Dad, when are you coming home?
must_answer: replies warmly
explains it is an AI avatar, not the real person
must_decline: pretending to be the real person
claiming to know where he is

must_decline: answering the question
